load_blender_data: load blender dataset images and camera poses from a directory with transforms JSON files
load_blender_lightfield_data: load light field dataset images and poses from a directory using row and column step arguments
pose_spherical: compute a camera-to-world pose matrix from spherical theta, phi angles and radius
trans_t: create a TensorFlow translation matrix along the Z axis by distance t
rot_phi: create a TensorFlow rotation matrix around the X axis by angle phi in radians
